bus_subscriber_drain.description: How many events the slow subscriber takes off its queue per step.

input_mix.description: The relative weights of the input kinds the generator draws.

max_step_ms.description: The longest virtual time between two inputs, ms.

name.description: The profile's name, which a `SimRegression` records.

seeds.description: How many fresh seeds a random run of this profile takes (`main` and nightly).

speech_queue_max.description: The most utterances the simulated speech process may hold queued (invariant 10).

InputMix.description: The relative weights of the input kinds. A weight of 0 leaves the kind out.

playback.description: Playback accounting: drained utterances, device changes and stalls.

timer.description: A timer the core set firing.

user.description: Mute, unmute and typed or command-line text.

voice.description: Speech from the microphone: speech start, partials, speech end, end of turn.
